title: Capture Devin cost metrics

story.so_that: workflow operators can reconcile AI spend against budgets, detect cost anomalies before they exceed targets, and demonstrate per-workflow cost accountability by observing, auditing, and reporting prompt, completion, cached-token, and monetary-cost usage for each Devin invocation without changing existing harness behavior or exit codes
story.as_a: workflow operator or cost-aware engineer running agentic workflows
story.i_want: every non-interactive Devin CLI invocation run through the harness to request an ATIF export, have its aggregate standard final_metrics parsed defensively, and expose normalized usage on HarnessResult while retaining the raw export for any additional billing dimensions

journey.before: Needs to understand token and cost usage of automated Devin invocations inside Cadence workflows and correlate that usage with workflow, run, and Activity identity
journey.during: Inspects the durable Activity log directory, retained ATIF trajectory, and optional HarnessResult usage for a specific invocation
journey.after: Audits retained trajectories and aggregates usage across workflow runs while trusting that missing or malformed telemetry never changed the Devin subprocess outcome

capability_breakdown.core_action: Run every non-interactive Devin CLI invocation with --export, retain the ATIF trajectory beside existing workflow logs when an Activity context is available, parse only the standard aggregate final_metrics defensively, and return a normalized HarnessUsage on HarnessResult; any additional Devin billing dimensions remain available in the raw ATIF export

optional temporary directory when no Activity context is available
Devin CLI ATIF export written to the chosen path
outputs: stdout and stderr from the devin subprocess
optional HarnessResult.usage with standard aggregate prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, and cost_usd metrics

temporary devin-trajectory.json file when no Activity context is available
state_changes: writes devin-trajectory.json into the current Activity attempt's artifact directory when a logging context exists

adds get_activity_artifact_dir() to the common workflow logging contract
allocates and cleans up a temporary export directory when the harness is called outside an Activity context

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every common.DevinHarness invocation requests an ATIF export.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a DevinHarness run is configured When the subprocess is executed Then devin is invoked with --export <path>
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Request ATIF export for every harness run

acceptance_criteria.criterion: An invocation inside an Activity logging context retains its trajectory beside that Activity's logs.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the harness is called inside an Activity logging context When the devin subprocess completes Then the ATIF trajectory is written to the Activity's artifact directory alongside activity.log and devin.log

acceptance_criteria.criterion: An invocation outside an Activity context still captures usage through a temporary export.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the harness is called without an Activity logging context When the devin subprocess completes Then the ATIF trajectory is written to a temporary directory, parsed, and the usage is returned without a durable path

acceptance_criteria.criterion: HarnessResult exposes optional normalized standard aggregate prompt, completion, cached-token, and USD-cost metrics.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a Devin invocation produced an ATIF document with aggregate final_metrics When the export is parsed Then HarnessResult.usage contains the supported standard prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, and cost_usd fields, while any additional billing dimensions remain in the raw ATIF export
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Expose normalized usage metrics on harness result

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing harness implementations remain compatible without supplying usage.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an existing test or caller constructs HarnessResult with only exit_code, stdout, and stderr When the result is used Then it is valid and usage defaults to None
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Maintain compatibility with existing harness implementations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Missing or malformed telemetry never changes the Devin subprocess exit result.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the devin subprocess exits with a specific code When the ATIF export is missing, unreadable, or malformed Then the harness returns the same exit_code with usage set to None
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Preserve subprocess result regardless of telemetry errors

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Concurrent Activities and retries do not overwrite one another's trajectories.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given each skill Activity calls the harness once per attempt and the logging layout scopes artifacts by Cadence attempt When concurrent Activities or retries write their ATIF exports Then each trajectory is stored in its own attempt-scoped, non-overwriting path
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Avoid trajectory overwrites across concurrent Activities and retries

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Raw trajectory data is not copied into normal Activity logs.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an ATIF trajectory contains prompts, tool calls, or file paths When the harness or logger writes diagnostics Then the Activity log contains only the export path and sanitized error category, not raw trajectory content
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Keep raw trajectory data out of Activity logs

edge_cases.criterion: ATIF export is missing after a successful Devin exit
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the devin subprocess exits with code 0 and no ATIF file is written When the harness completes Then it returns exit_code 0 and usage set to None
edge_cases.jtbd: Tolerate a missing export on success

edge_cases.gherkin: Given the ATIF file exists but is not valid JSON When the harness parses it Then it returns usage set to None and preserves the original Devin exit_code

edge_cases.criterion: ATIF final_metrics is not a JSON object
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the ATIF document is valid but final_metrics is a string or null When the harness parses it Then it returns usage set to None

edge_cases.criterion: Token or cost fields have the wrong type
edge_cases.gherkin: Given final_metrics contains a boolean for total_prompt_tokens or total_cost_usd When the harness normalizes values Then the affected fields become None and other valid fields are retained

edge_cases.criterion: final_metrics contains only a subset of supported standard fields or additional billing dimensions
edge_cases.gherkin: Given final_metrics provides only total_prompt_tokens plus an additional billing dimension When the export is parsed Then HarnessResult.usage contains prompt_tokens with other supported fields as None and the additional dimension remains available only in the raw ATIF export
edge_cases.jtbd: Handle partial standard metrics without discarding raw billing data

edge_cases.criterion: No Activity logging context is available
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the harness is called outside an Activity logging context When the devin subprocess completes Then the export is written to a temporary directory, parsed, and no durable trajectory path is retained
edge_cases.jtbd: Capture usage without a workflow Activity context

edge_cases.criterion: Concurrent Activity attempts or retries share a workflow run
edge_cases.gherkin: Given two concurrent Activity attempts or a retry write to the same workflow run's activity directory When each export is written Then each trajectory is stored in a distinct attempt-scoped path
edge_cases.jtbd: Keep concurrent and retry attempts isolated

edge_cases.criterion: Devin subprocess exits nonzero with a valid ATIF export
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the devin subprocess exits with a nonzero code and a valid ATIF file is produced When the harness returns Then the exit_code is nonzero and usage is populated
edge_cases.jtbd: Capture usage even when the skill fails

edge_cases.criterion: Workflow or activity identifiers contain path-unsafe characters
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a workflow_id, run_id, or activity_id contains slashes, dots, or unicode When the artifact directory is derived Then the path components are sanitized to prevent traversal
edge_cases.jtbd: Sanitize identifiers used as filesystem paths

edge_cases.gherkin: Given the Activity artifact directory is unwriteable When the harness attempts to write the export Then it still returns the Devin result, usage is None, and the error is logged as a sanitized category
Given the ATIF document is large enough to contain many turns When the harness parses final_metrics Then it reads only the aggregate object and does not copy raw trajectory content into Activity logs

definition_of_done: Unit and integration tests cover ATIF parsing of supported standard aggregate metrics, export path selection, backward-compatible HarnessResult construction, failure semantics, and concurrent/retry isolation.
The implementation assumes Devin's ATIF final_metrics are aggregate totals inclusive of subagent usage; this assumption is documented and does not require subagent-level parsing in this story.

The PathAware workflow logger, Devin harness, and related harness integration are migrated to common as necessary, and the harness consumes the attempt-scoped artifact directory through get_activity_artifact_dir().
ATIF log retention policy and lifecycle management are excluded because another service owns retention.

Skill Activity result-level cost reporting and workflow-level cost aggregation are explicitly deferred; the future workflow aggregate is defined as the sum of all Activity aggregates across the workflow call.

recommendation.approach: Implement in this order: (1) migrate the PathAware workflow logger into common and migrate Devin/harness integrations where necessary, exposing the current Cadence attempt-scoped artifact directory through get_activity_artifact_dir(); (2) add the backward-compatible HarnessUsage and optional HarnessResult.usage fields for supported standard aggregate metrics; (3) implement a defensive ATIF usage parser in a dedicated module with unit tests; (4) add durable and temporary export-path selection to DevinHarness.run(); (5) wire --export into the Devin CLI command and return parsed usage; (6) verify retry and concurrent Activity isolation using the existing local Cadence stack and worker runtimes. Treat final_metrics as aggregate totals inclusive of subagent usage. Preserve additional billing dimensions in the raw ATIF export without normalizing them. Defer retention, Skill Activity result-level cost reporting, and workflow-level aggregation.
recommendation.rationale: The clarified scope removes the implementation blockers. Activity logging already isolates Cadence attempts, each skill Activity calls the harness exactly once per attempt, and the local Cadence stack and worker runtimes already exist. Missing or malformed ATIF telemetry must never change the Devin exit code, and the existing HarnessResult constructor remains valid. Exporting the raw ATIF preserves possible additional Devin billing dimensions while the result contract stays focused on supported standard aggregate metrics. A later story can add cost to Skill Activity results and compute the workflow aggregate as the sum of all Activity aggregates across the workflow call.
